author: FunForLouis
description:
Eight days in China with my dad @MrColeCooks We started in Chengdu with room-service robots, a light show on the Twin Towers and giant pandas, then caught a high speed train towards the turquoise lakes and waterfalls of Jiuzhaigou. That night, my dad threw a wish into a bonfire.

Next came 600 steps up to the Long March Monument, exploring in ancient Songpan and a Tibetan banquet that nearly brought my dad to tears. The next morning, we hiked up to a lookout in the dark, then found out some mountains have escalators??! We rode one up to watch the sun set over the Yellow River.

We went birdwatching at Flower Lake, got stuck behind yaks on the way to Zhagana and hiked up a waterfall gorge into the clouds. Then we took the train to Lanzhou, where we painted gourds, caught the sunset at Zhongshan Bridge and finished with a street food tour. Cooked durian was genuinely delicious.

I’m so glad I got to do this with my dad. Episode 1 of our China adventure is up now on YouTube!
title: Everything We Did On Our 8 Day China Adventure!
